prayerExcerpt.en-US: O God, exaltation of the lowly, grant that we may happily attain the rewards promised to the humble.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Ó Deus, grandeza dos pequenos, concedei-nos alcançar com alegria o prêmio prometido aos humildes.

meta.face: A very old but robust hermit of about seventy-five with a BROAD, SQUARE, weathered face seen in the shadow of the hood — a low, wide forehead, a short, broad, slightly flattened nose, small, kindly, deep-set brown eyes under heavy, bushy dark-grey brows, full, ruddy, rounded cheeks, a wide, full-lipped mouth; no hair visible under the hood; a full, BROAD, squared-off grey beard of medium length, streaked with dark, covering the chin like a spade (NOT long, thin or wispy), and a warm, steady, fatherly gaze out at the viewer. Nothing gaunt or hollow-cheeked.
meta.basis: He lived to ninety-one; the paintings after his death (Tiepolo's altarpiece among them) show a gaunt, hooded old hermit with a long grey beard and a staff, holding or beneath the CHARITAS sun. The hood and the forked wispy beard keep him apart from the bareheaded elders.
